translations.web: But I worked for my name’s sake, that it should not be profaned in the sight of the nations, in whose sight I brought them out.
translations.bsb: But I acted for the sake of My name, so that it would not be profaned in the eyes of the nations in whose sight I had brought them out.
translations.kjv: But I wrought for my name's sake, that it should not be polluted before the heathen, in whose sight I brought them out.
translations.asv: But I wrought for my name's sake, that it should not be profaned in the sight of the nations, in whose sight I brought them out.
